data.title: Pension account clarification: study period not recognised
data.summary: The pension insurer (Muster-Rentenversicherung Bund) wrote on 27 November 2025 to confirm your insurance record for periods older than six calendar years. Your studies from 1 October 2008 to 30 September 2011 were not recorded as a credited period because no degree was proven.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) on your pension account clarification (Kontenklärung). Older data in your insurance record is now binding. Your study period was not credited as a qualifying period (Anrechnungszeit) because proof of graduation is missing. If you disagree, or can supply your degree certificate, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or on record with the insurer; the app shows the deadline. Filing at another domestic authority in time also counts. Consider seeking advice from a pension advisor if unsure.

items.title: Object to the account clarification decision

date.text: binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe

items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or on record with Muster-Rentenversicherung Bund if you disagree, e.g. with proof of your degree.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final and the study period stays uncredited.
